snippet.title: DHEA for IVF: What 28 Trials Found
snippet.description:
A large Cochrane review pooled 28 randomized trials of DHEA and testosterone, mostly in women who respond poorly to stimulation. The answer, with moderate certainty: DHEA probably makes little or no difference to live births. DHEA isn't a vitamin; it's a hormone, with hormone side effects like acne, and the 2025 ESHRE guideline doesn't recommend it before or during stimulation. Evidence Score 0 (tested, probably no difference) on Dr Aksoy's teaching scale, not an official score.

Full video: https://youtu.be/2hjpsL0bwhM

Sources:
• Naik et al., Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 2024: https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD009749.pub3
• ESHRE 2025 ovarian stimulation guideline: https://doi.org/10.1093/humrep/deag018

English voice generated with AI from Dr Aksoy's own voice; lip movements adjusted with AI. Educational only, not personal medical advice. Don't start or stop anything without your own doctor.
